source_caption_text:
Detroit rapper #SadaBaby is speaking out after facing questions about why he refused to take a video with a fan, explaining that his decision came down to safety concerns and protecting his personal whereabouts.

While taking pictures with fans is something many artists are comfortable with, videos can sometimes create additional risks, especially when it comes to privacy and location security. 

A video can capture background details, recognizable landmarks, nearby businesses, street signs, or other surroundings that could potentially reveal exactly where an artist is at a given moment.

Sada Baby would rather take photos with fans in certain situations because a single picture may be less likely to expose his real-time location than a video showing more of his surroundings. 

Depending on what is captured, even a seemingly innocent fan interaction could unintentionally give away information that compromises an artist’s safety.

In today’s social media era, where content can be uploaded and shared within seconds, protecting personal space and staying aware of one’s surroundings has become increasingly important for artists and public figures. 

Do you blame him?
